description:
Configure the FreeScout system-wide mail settings to use an internal SMTP relay. Navigate to Manage > Settings > Mail Settings and configure the following:

- Mail Driver: SMTP
- Host: 127.0.0.1
- Port: 1025
- Encryption: None
- Username: (leave empty)
- Password: (leave empty)
- From Email: notifications@helpdesk.local
- From Name: Internal Helpdesk

Save the settings. You may send a test email to admin@helpdesk.local to verify the connection, but it is not required for completion.
